description: Optional patches of the game's executable (docs/plans/graphics/IMAGE_QUALITY_PLAN.md). Each word is [address, original, patched]. Instruction words are listed under code: prepare_runtime.py makes the generated code read them from guest memory, so applying a patch is a memory write. The runtime's table (runtime/ee/game_patches.cpp) holds the same words; tools/ps2recomp/test_prepare_runtime.py checks that they agree.

widescreen.source: PCSX2 patch database, patches/SLUS-21441_FE961D28.pnach, Widescreen 16:9; 0x00386D94 (the story map's projection) added by the port
